request: Upgrade React Native from 0.87.1 to 0.88.1 following docs/migrations/react-native-0.87.1-to-0.88.1.template.diff (the template app RnDiffApp is dota2App here): bump react, react-native, @react-native/* and react-test-renderer in package.json, adopt the 0.88 SceneDelegate/AppDelegate/Info.plist changes keeping the module name dota2App and a readable status bar on the dark theme, and update the React Native version in the readme tech stack (not in docs/benchmarks.md or the OpenClaw docs, which record what was measured then). Do not run package managers yourself: the harness installs the dependencies (scripts/deps_install.sh) before each gate and runs pod install plus an iOS rebuild (scripts/ios_build.sh) before the screenshots, and sends you their output if they fail. Every screen must still render.
